user.title: Add an RF device
user.description: Name the device, pick its primary entity type, and choose which RF transmitter to use.

entity_options.title: Options for {entity_type}
entity_options.description: Configure the specific options for this entity. You'll learn each button next.

data.fan_light_mode: Does your fan have a light? How is it switched?
data.fan_light_extras: Optional light buttons (colour cycle, colour presets, brightness)
data.has_oscillation: Fan has a physical oscillation button
data.has_swing_air: Fan has a swing air/breeze toggle
data.has_natural_breeze: Fan has a natural breeze/wind mode
data.has_on_button: Remote has a separate On button
data.direct_capture: Skip the frequency sweep (try this if the remote won't detect)

learn_press.title: Release, then press again
learn_press.description: Locked onto the **{button}** button's signal. Let go of it now. Then select **Submit** and press **{button}** once more to capture the code.

learn_result.title: Captured
learn_result.description: Got {pulses} pulses for the **{button}** button. Send it to test, keep it, or try again.

menu_options.skip: Skip and keep any previous signal
menu_options.choose_test_mode: Choose and test a replay mode

learn_error.title: Nothing captured
learn_error.description: No code came through for the **{button}** button ({error}). Try again, or capture without the frequency sweep — that works for remotes the sweep can't lock onto (just one press at the set frequency).

menu_options.skip: Skip and keep any previous signal

remote_manager.title: Remote command manager
remote_manager.description: Select a learned button to inspect, test, rename or reassign.

manage_command.title: Manage button
manage_command.description: Testing transmits immediately. Confirm the physical response before keeping a mode. Changes are saved with Save changes in the main menu.

choose_test_mode.title: Test replay mode
choose_test_mode.description: Select a mode, then confirm whether the fan physically responds.

test.title: Transmission failed
test.description: Check the selected mode and transmitter. Submit to return without saving.

reassign.title: Reassign command
reassign.description: Copy the signal to a different function. The source remains available.

rename_command.title: Rename button
rename_command.description: Changes the displayed button label while keeping its identity.

command_library.title: Command library
command_library.description: Reuse a command from another remote with the same RF frequency.

library_copy.title: Copy library command
library_copy.description: Enter a function key such as speed_2, timer_2h, or a new custom button key.

export_import.title: Backup / export / import
export_import.description: Copy the export text to a file for safekeeping. Paste an export below to merge signals. Submit without import text to return. All changes remain pending until Save changes.

fan_settings.title: Fan and startup settings
fan_settings.description: Select learned speed levels and the assumed state after a restart. This does not send RF.

finish.title: Save changes
finish.description:
{summary}
A private backup is created before saving. Submit to apply changes.

progress.sweep: Press and hold the **{button}** button on your remote, and keep holding until the next screen appears.
progress.capture: Now press the **{button}** button once to capture it.
progress.press: Press the **{button}** button on your remote once now to capture it.

abort.no_rf_device: No RF-capable Broadlink device found. Set up your RM4 Pro (or similar) in the Broadlink integration first.
abort.invalid_import: The command source is unavailable or incompatible.

error.send_failed: Transmission failed. No physical response has been confirmed. Try another mode or check the transmitter.
error.overwrite_required: Tick the replacement checkbox to overwrite an existing signal.
error.invalid_import: Invalid export, checksum, command format or RF frequency.
error.missing_speeds: Learn all requested speeds first, using Add fan speeds.

init.title: Configure RF device
init.description: Choose an option from the alphabetical list. Changes apply after Save changes at the bottom.

relearn.title: Re-learn a button
relearn.description: Select any number of buttons. Test, retry or skip each one, then save changes.

add_fan_speeds.title: Add more fan speeds
add_fan_speeds.description: Choose the total number of slider steps, up to 8. You will only be asked to learn the new speed buttons; existing speeds remain unchanged. Choose Done in the main menu to save.

fan_power_settings.title: Fan power button style
fan_power_settings.description: Choose how the remote controls fan power. A single toggle button sends the same learned command for On and Off. Existing learned speeds are preserved. Choose Done in the main menu to save.

add_entity.title: Add a new entity
add_entity.description: Choose the type and give it a name. You'll learn its buttons next.

add_entity_options.title: Options for {entity_type} — {name}
add_entity_options.description: Configure the specific options for this new entity.

add_dc_features.title: Learn extra fan buttons
add_dc_features.description: Select only buttons present on your remote. Existing learned codes are kept. Choose Done in the main menu to save. To replace a learned code, use Re-learn a button.

remove_commands.title: Remove learned buttons
remove_commands.description: All currently learned optional buttons are selected. Untick only the buttons you want to delete. Off and fan speeds are protected.

confirm_remove_commands.title: Confirm button removal
confirm_remove_commands.description: Delete these learned buttons and their controls? **{buttons}**

replay_settings.title: Signal replay settings
replay_settings.description: Use Captured signal for ordinary RF remotes. Mercator filtering is specific to supported Mercator remotes. Choose Done in the main menu to save.

create_dashboard.title: Create / refresh remote dashboard
create_dashboard.description: Create controls for your saved RF devices in the sidebar. This takes effect immediately and keeps a backup of any previous generated dashboard. Learn or save new commands first.

dashboard_ready.title: Your remote dashboard is ready
dashboard_ready.description: [Open RF Fan remotes](/rf-fan-remotes). You can also find it in the sidebar. Submit to return to Configure.
